answer: Each identity joins one island; only other-island attestations count. Three cross-island attestations are needed; each attestor stakes 30 credits, 60 on a second slot, charging half the stake. Cross-island share below the nadir line of two-thirds means zero weight; the cross-island minus same-island delta is published for replay. With two slots per attestor per epoch, 1,000 fakes need 3,000 slots, 1,500 attestors, 40,000 in bonds plus 67,500 in fees. A self-attestation ring fails: its attestations are discarded, its bonds flagged. One honest agent posts a 40-credit bond and keeps full weight.
